title: Dio Chrysostom, Orations 1–4 On Kingship (Περὶ βασιλείας; Or. 4 'Alexander and Diogenes') / Дион Хрисостом, Речи о царской власти
author: Dio Chrysostom (Dio of Prusa)
edition: von Arnim, Dionis Prusaensis opera I (1893), public domain. Loeb Greek–English, Dio Chrysostom vol. I (Cohoon 1932).
ru_evidence: Russian Wikipedia 'Дион Хрисостом' lists Russian translations only of Or. 6–12, 18, 21, 36, 51, 53 and 55; Or. 1–4 (and 31–34) are absent.
en_evidence: Loeb Classical Library, Dio Chrysostom I (J. W. Cohoon, 1932), covering Or. 1–11. Other modern English versions exist.
other_translations: Several full translations into Western European languages (Spanish, Italian, German); not individually re-verified.
value: Central text for Trajanic imperial ideology and Cynic-Stoic kingship theory. Or. 2 and Or. 4 stage Alexander with Philip and with Diogenes, so it is directly relevant to Alexander studies. A notable gap for Russian readers.
ai_feasibility: High. Clear Atticist prose with rich secondary literature for cross-checking; low lexical risk.
